LLMAnalysisResult_top_5_target_search_qu.title: Top 5 Target Search Queries
LLMAnalysisResult_top_5_target_search_qu.description: Exactly 5 relevant qualitative target search queries across Google, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and X grounded in page content. When the page content is sparse, generate plausible queries from the available brand and category signals and label them as AI-generated suggestions in business_relevance.

LLMAnalysisResult_top_5_services.title: Top 5 Services
LLMAnalysisResult_top_5_services.description: Exactly 5 services with explicit labeling distinguishing website-extracted services (source_type='extracted_from_website') from inferred recommendations (source_type='inferred_recommendation'). When the website explicitly lists fewer than 5 services, fill remaining entries as inferred recommendations grounded in the brand category and content. Never fabricate services as extracted.
